name: Granulate Ambrosia Beetle
desc: Granulate Ambrosia Beetle (Xylosandrus crassiusculus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Xylosandrus crassiusculus, known generally as the Asian ambrosia beetle or granulate ambrosia beetle, is a species of tropical bark beetle in the family Curculionidae.
